items.text: Eagles ruled out WR DeVonta Smith for Sunday’s game vs. Rams due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: PHI WR targets concentrate; Hurts volume may shift.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for Wicks and remaining receivers; Goedert also out compounds TE/WR usage.

items.text: Aaron Donald is out for Sunday’s game vs. the Eagles due to his back injury. Puka Nacua is expected to play.
items.why: Hip/groin; full practice Friday, no designation.
items.implication: Rams WR1 returns after missing two games; Adams usage may dilute slightly but overall offense boost.
items.opportunity: High route/target share restored for Nacua; red-zone upside.

items.text: Vikings WR Justin Jefferson is out Sunday due to his sprained ankle.
items.why: Sprained ankle from Week 3; missed practice all week.
items.implication: Vikings pass game without top target; Addison and others elevate.
items.opportunity: Increased targets/routes for secondary WRs in MIN offense.

items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall for Sunday’s game vs. the Bears (quad).
items.why: Quad/thigh injury from Week 3; DNP practices.
items.implication: Jets backfield leads to backup volume spike.
items.opportunity: Full or near-full snap/carry share for primary backup (Allen profile as RB2).

items.text: Players out for Sunday include Jayden Daniels, ... Dallas Goedert, ... Caleb Williams, ... among others (full list covers multiple teams).
items.why: Various (elbow for Daniels, knee for Goedert, etc.); final outs list.
items.implication: WAS without starting QB; PHI TE void; CHI without Williams.
items.opportunity: Backup QBs elevate; PHI TE targets to others; CHI skill adjustments.

items.text: Kyle Shanahan said WR Mike Evans, who is dealing with a rib injury, will be a game-time decision.
items.why: Ribs; intends to play through with padding per beat.
items.implication: If out, Kittle and others rise; if in, limited but usable.
items.opportunity: Monitor for active; reverse beneficiaries if unexpectedly IN.

items.text: Tough runout for Jadarian Price: lost goal-line/base to Emmanuel Wilson, pass-downs to George Holani, fumbles, chest injury, and Zach Charbonnet (ACL) back at practice. Passes eye test long-term though. Projections updated for Price (chest).
items.why: Chest injury + role erosion confirmed in Schefter outs list; Charbonnet practicing.
items.implication: Near-term fantasy fade; longer-term stash if eye test holds.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/third-down shares shift to Wilson/Holani/Charbonnet; monitor SEA RB committee.

items.text: Ravens QB Lamar Jackson is off the injury report and good to go Sunday vs. the Titans.
items.implication: Full dual-threat QB1 confirmed; Ravens offense at full strength.
items.opportunity: Standard high snap/rush share and pass volume for skill players.

items.text: Nico Collins is good to go.
items.implication: HOU WR1 returns; full target share expected.

items.text: With Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has seen a solid 13.8% target share (vs 8.3% prior). On pace for 64 catches after 26 in 14 games last year. Only 4-game sample.
items.why: Sampson absence drives pass-game role expansion; data-backed pace.
items.implication: PPR RB2/flex with receiving upside beyond pure rush work.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share, routes, and third-down usage in CLE backfield.

items.text: Jaylen Warren on LOVE list: led RBs with 90% snap rate last week, 20 of 22 RB touches. Dowdle out again. CLE allows 88+ yards to RB every game. Top-10 play.
items.why: Workhorse snaps/touches with teammate out; strong matchup.
items.opportunity: Near-100% snap share, carries, and receiving work.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love on LOVE list: RB5 utilization, 26 touches last week (more than W1+W2 combined). Double-digit target share every game. NYG allows 5.1 YPC (3rd-most).
items.why: Exploding usage + soft run defense matchup.

items.text: Drake London on LOVE: 35% career target share/104 YPG with Penix; 43.5% share (9-194) in Penix return. NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Elite target share with Penix healthy; favorable WR TD matchup.

items.text: Omarion Hampton on HATE list: RB27 utilization, 3.5% target share, 25% routes, snap rate down to 42% W3 (13% third downs). SEA allows 2.9 YPC (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Poor usage profile + tough run defense.
items.implication: Sit/avoid in most formats; low floor.
